model.datahub_dbt.agg_daily_revenue.compiled_code:
-- Chiffre d'affaires quotidien.
select
    order_date,
    count(*)                                                    as order_count,
    count(*) filter (where is_revenue)                          as revenue_order_count,
    sum(case when is_revenue then order_amount else 0 end)      as revenue,
    sum(paid_amount)                                            as cash_collected,
    sum(outstanding_amount)                                     as outstanding,
    round(avg(order_amount), 2)                                 as avg_basket
from "datahub_dev"."marts"."fct_orders"
group by order_date

model.datahub_dbt.dim_customers.compiled_code:
-- Dimension clients : profil + indicateurs de cycle de vie.
with customers as (
    select * from "datahub_dev"."staging"."stg_customers"
),

countries as (
    select * from "datahub_dev"."reference"."country_codes"
),

orders as (
    select * from "datahub_dev"."marts"."fct_orders"
),

customer_orders as (
    select
        customer_id,
        min(order_date)                                         as first_order_date,
        max(order_date)                                         as last_order_date,
        count(*)                                                as order_count,
        sum(case when is_revenue then order_amount else 0 end)  as lifetime_value
    from orders
    group by customer_id
)

select
    customers.customer_id,
    customers.first_name,
    customers.last_name,
    customers.email,
    customers.country_code,
    countries.country_name,
    countries.region,
    customers.created_at,
    customer_orders.first_order_date,
    customer_orders.last_order_date,
    coalesce(customer_orders.order_count, 0)        as order_count,
    coalesce(customer_orders.lifetime_value, 0)     as lifetime_value,
    case
        when coalesce(customer_orders.lifetime_value, 0) >= 1000 then 'gold'
        when coalesce(customer_orders.lifetime_value, 0) >= 300 then 'silver'
        else 'bronze'
    end                                             as customer_tier
from customers
left join countries using (country_code)
left join customer_orders using (customer_id)

model.datahub_dbt.fct_orders.compiled_code:
-- Table de faits des commandes, enrichie des paiements.
-- Incrémentale : Dagster passe la fenêtre de partition (vars min_date / max_date)
-- ce qui rend les backfills idempotents.
with orders as (
    select * from "datahub_dev"."staging"."stg_orders"
    
    where order_date >= (
            select coalesce(max(order_date), date '1900-01-01') - interval 3 day
            from "datahub_dev"."marts"."fct_orders"
        )
    
),

payments as (
    select * from "datahub_dev"."intermediate"."int_order_payments"
)

select
    orders.order_id,
    orders.customer_id,
    orders.order_date,
    orders.status,
    orders.product_category,
    orders.amount                                       as order_amount,
    coalesce(payments.paid_amount, 0)                   as paid_amount,
    coalesce(payments.payment_count, 0)                 as payment_count,
    orders.amount - coalesce(payments.paid_amount, 0)   as outstanding_amount,
    orders.status in ('completed', 'shipped')           as is_revenue,
    orders.partition_date,
    current_timestamp                                   as dbt_updated_at
from orders
left join payments using (order_id)

test.datahub_dbt.assert_revenue_not_grea.compiled_code:
-- Le CA quotidien ne peut pas dépasser la somme des montants de commandes du jour.
select a.order_date
from "datahub_dev"."marts"."agg_daily_revenue" a
join (
    select order_date, sum(order_amount) as total
    from "datahub_dev"."marts"."fct_orders"
    group by order_date
) f using (order_date)
where a.revenue > f.total
test.datahub_dbt.assert_revenue_not_grea.name: assert_revenue_not_greater_than_orders
